gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histological diagnosis of meningioma according to the WHO 2021 classification

candidate_evidence.quote: Arm A (interventional arm): REGORAFENIB 40 mg tablets once daily (160 mg/die), 3 weeks on, 1 week off, until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The focus of this study will be to investigate whether Regorafenib demonstrates antitumor activity against recurrent meningiomas.

role_evidence.quote: Arm A (interventional arm): REGORAFENIB 40 mg tablets once daily (160 mg/die), 3 weeks on, 1 week off, until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity

agents.drug_class_hint: multikinase (VEGFR) inhibitor approved for colorectal cancer, GIST, HCC
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Regorafenib inhibits angiogenic receptor tyrosine kinases (RTKs) and is highly selective for VEGFR1/2/3; moreover Regorafenib inhibits PDGFRB, FGFR1 and oncogenic intracellular signalling cascades involving c-RAF/RAF1 and BRAF highly expressed in meningiomas.

role_evidence.quote: Local Standard of Care: In this setting there are not drugs with indication. Every site will treat patients as per their experience.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigator's choice local standard of care, no drug named

coder_notes: Meningioma trial; glioblastoma mentioned only as background (REGOMA) in the brief summary, so not_glioblastoma. VEGF/VEGFR overexpression is background rationale, not a planned biomarker. Control arm is a registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR with unspecified local standard of care.
